9799.d: Etceteria is a settlement located on an island east of the kingdom of Miscellania.

gt.heading: Getting there
gt.text:
• Players with level 83 Farming can grow a Spirit tree on Etceteria and then use the spirit trees to teleport to and from the tree on the island. Players must have completed the Tree Gnome Village quest to teleport using spirit trees.
• Fairy ring code CIP teleports the player north of the castle on Miscellania. Players must have progressed through part of the A Fairy Tale II - Cure a Queen quest to teleport using fairy rings.
• Players with a ring of Wealth, ring of Fortune, or luck of the Dwarves can teleport directly to Miscellania, then walk across the bridge to Etceteria. Miscellania teleport is unlocked on the rings after completion of the Throne of Miscellania quest.
• Players can travel between Rellekka and Miscellania (and then on to Etceteria) via boat, by talking to or right-clicking the nearby Sailor, who shall let you use the boat only if you have completed The Fremennik Trials quest. In Rellekka the boat is located at the docks just north of the marketplace. In Miscellania the boat is located at the dock on the south-eastern part of the island. When arriving at Miscellania, players wearing Fremennik sea boots 2 or better can jump from the north end of the dock onto Etceteria. This is considerably faster than walking north to the bridge connecting the two islands.
• Players with level 30 Construction can move their Player-owned house to Rellekka for 10,000 coins. They can then simply use the House Teleport spell, leave the house, and then walk a short distance north to get the boat to Miscellania.
• Using the Fremennik Province lodestone, which is east of Rellekka and north-east of its entrance. Players can teleport using the lodestone, then take the boat to Miscellania/Etceteria.

9844.d: The Everlight Dig Site is a former icyene settlement and dig site located east of Meiyerditch.

gt.heading: Getting there
gt.text:
There are a variety of ways to travel to the Everlight dig site:
• Archaeology teleport, purchased for 250 chronotes from Ezreal at the Archaeology Guild Shop
• Archaeology journal, teleport to the Archaeology Campus then running west, inside the main building, and use the dig sites map table inside to teleport to it directly
• Ectophial, teleport to Port Phasmatys then run south
• Fairy ring (code ALQ), teleport to the Haunted Woods, run south-east then south
• Games necklace, teleport to Burgh de Rott, take the boat to the icyene graveyard then climb the shortcut
• Drakan's medallion, teleport to Burgh de Rott, take the boat to the icyene graveyard then climb the shortcut
• Boss portal (either in the Max Guild or War's Retreat), teleport to the Araxyte Hive then run south

9894.d: The Exalted Quarry is a mine south of Heathervein and north of Berylbrook.

gt.heading: Getting there
gt.text:
• Home teleport to Wendlewick and take a canoe to either:
• Amberfell 4, then head north-east through Berylbrook.
• Heathervein 5, head west. (This is the quickest way).
• Travel to the Moonrise Dig Site, walk east through Amberfell and Berylbrook.
• Fairy ring code DLP to Amberfell, head east.
• Without access to the canoe stations or fairy ring network:
• # Home teleport to Wendlewick.
• # Head east to Amberfell using the bridge south of Ivar, King of Bones.
• # Climb over the barricade east of Amberfell (next to Ash).
• # Head north-east through Berylbrook.
• Stonevein amulet Wolf and go east.

9895.d: The Exam Centre is a location in Misthalin east of Varrock, in the southern part of Archaeology Campus and is central to several quests.

gt.heading: Getting there
gt.text: The fastest way to get to the Exam Centre is to use a Dig Site pendant. Archaeology journal teleports to a short distance to the northwest. Alternatively, the Varrock lodestone or the gnome glider transportation system could be used, selecting the destination "Lemanto Andra".
